# Cancel Patch Update without deleting edits

The imported Task 4 summary records a user requirement to stop Patch Update while retaining unfinished edits. It reports cancellation through an abort controller, `turn/interrupt` with exact thread and turn IDs, command/build signals, a two-second acknowledgement timeout, and local-agent shutdown fallback. `cancelGraphPatchUpdateSession` must retain a cancelled dirty worktree so cancellation does not destroy edits. The summary reports focused cancellation tests, but says the review-dialog finish remained uncertain; this does not establish complete UI validation.

Scope: console patch update.
